question: The value of ((0.27)²-(0.13)²)/(0.27space+space0.13) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply the algebraic identity: **a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)**.

The given expression is in the form **(a² − b²) ÷ (a + b)**, which simplifies to **(a − b)**.

Here, **a = 0.27** and **b = 0.13**.

Result = 0.27 − 0.13 = 0.14.

**∴ The correct answer is 0.14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = ((0.27)² − (0.13)²) ÷ (0.27 + 0.13)

**Formula used:**

**Algebraic Identity:** a² − b² = (a + b)(a − b)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let **a = 0.27** and **b = 0.13**.

⇒ The numerator is (0.27)² − (0.13)².

⇒ Using the identity, Numerator = (0.27 + 0.13) × (0.27 − 0.13)

⇒ Numerator = (0.40) × (0.14)

⇒ The denominator is (0.27 + 0.13) = 0.40.

⇒ Value = [(0.40) × (0.14)] ÷ 0.40

⇒ Value = 0.14

**∴ The correct answer is 0.14.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Difference of Squares

The identity **a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)** is one of the most common **algebraic factorization** tools used to simplify complex fraction expressions.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the **BODMAS** (Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, Subtraction) priority while solving multi-step calculations to ensure accuracy.

Sum and Difference Identities

Other related identities include **(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²** and **(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²**, which are useful for simplifying square terms.</p
